purpose.zh: 活动胸椎旋转，缓解久坐僵硬
purpose.en: Ease stiffness from sitting by rotating your upper back.

text.zh: 坐高，身体转向一侧，手扶椅背
text.en: Sit tall, turn your trunk to one side and hold the backrest

text.zh: 另一只手放在对侧膝盖外侧
text.en: Place the other hand on the outside of the opposite knee.

text.zh: 每次呼气稍微多转一点，再慢慢回正
text.en: Turn a little more on each exhale, then come back slowly.

commonErrors.en: Yanking with the hands to go further.

cautions.zh: 腰背疼痛时减小扭转幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Turn less if your back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
